config.design: Reuse existing document-hashed FineWeb windows; deduplicate documents across63panels then deterministic hash-sort.2048train/256validation/256test documents,16fixed positions per128token window. Sites: persistent layer0 values and residual after blocks0,1,2. No task labels/prompts used.
config.training_plan: Pilot block dimensions1,4,16 at fixed total decoder width2304 and active scalar budget32; three seeds. Train centered/global-scaled activations, no per-example normalization. Choose checkpoints only on validation; test reserved for final evaluation. Compare reconstruction, effective block rank, occupancy and across-seed subspace stability before interpreting blocks.
config.limitations: Documents reused from research, not model-training holdout. Natural corpus duplicates beyond exact full-document hashes may remain. First128 tokens of existing sampled windows, not necessarily document beginnings. Purely lexical persistent values require identity-conditioned controls.
